title: Caribbean Peril Codes (v2.8)
text:
Caribbean Peril Codes (v2.8)
 

Peril codes for select countries in the Caribbean supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

UNICEDE
/2 supports the following codes for Perils Covered for risks in Bahamas,
 Barbados, Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Dominican Republic, Jamaica, St. Maarten, St. Martin
 and Trinidad and Tobago:

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PWS | Windstorm only |
| PEQ | Earthquake only |
